answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 16668 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assa la mu alaikum Q Is it permissible to give zakah to a person(who has no savings), who is in debt due to borrowing money from a bank to buy a house etc on Intrest (Mortgage)? Question: Assa la mu alaikum Q Is it permissible to give zakah to a person(who has no savings), who is in debt due to borrowing money from a bank to buy a house etc on Intrest (Mortgage)? Answer ID: 16668 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1667/1330/L=1430) If he has no cash amount and has some debts to be paid, he can receive Zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
